study_identification_part.si_4_title: Atypical maturation of the functional connectome hierarchy in autism

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized ABIDE-I (discovery dataset), ABIDE-II (replication dataset), and HCP-D (Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development) for normative modeling.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II... were analyzed... we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset
